jobs.title: Compliance & Security Lead
jobs.description: About Trigger.dev Trigger.dev is an open source platform used by developers to build production-grade AI agents. It's an SDK and the infrastructure to run agents reliably at scale, so teams can focus on the product instead of the plumbing. Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. With the rise of AI, being able to offload async tasks reliably is a key part of any developer's toolkit: We're building the infrastructure to make that a reality. About the position We're looking for our first Compliance & Security Lead to own security compliance and data protection at Trigger.dev. You'll report to the founders, and work closely with engineering. We already hold SOC 2 Type II, run our program through Oneleet, and publish a trust portal covering SOC 2, GDPR and HIPAA. Until now the founders and engineers have handled compliance alongside their day jobs. As we grow, customers send more security questionnaires, ask for more reports and negotiate more DPAs. Now we need somebody to own this, keep it running all year, and free our engineers to build. You don’t need to be an engineer, but technical experience is a bonus. This role suits someone process-minded who likes making compliance practical, rather than just ticking boxes. What you'll be doing You'll do a variety of things including: Running our SOC 2 and HIPAA programs: owning our SOC 2 audit, managing evidence collection in Oneleet and keeping us audit-ready all year Using AI and automation to speed up compliance work, from drafting questionnaire answers to collecting evidence and reviewing policies Completing security questionnaires and vendor assessments, sharing our reports and bridge letters, and keeping our trust portal current Reviewing and negotiating DPAs with customers and suppliers, working with our lawyers, keeping our records of processing up to date and handling data subject requests under UK and EU GDPR Writing and maintaining

jobs.title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team. Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers. We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions. This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes. What You'll Be Doing Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance. Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process. Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements. Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets. Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective. Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose. jobs.title: Field Intelligence Analyst (Remote, UAE)
jobs.description: About Sayari : Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv. About the Role Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do. The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard. You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it. Why This Role Exists Customers buy answers. jobs.title: Manager*in GMP Manufacturing Compliance – Oligonukleotide (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Werde Teil von Axolabs – Wo Innovation auf Wirkung trifft im Bereich RNA-Therapeutika Bei Axolabs arbeitest du in einem internationalen Team, das wegweisende Fortschritte in der Entwicklung von Nukleinsäure-basierten Arzneimitteln erzielt – von der computergestützten Wirkstoffentwicklung über Hochdurchsatz-Screening bis hin zur großtechnischen Herstellung. Unsere interdisziplinären Teams vereinen Expertise in Oligonukleotid-Chemie, Bioinformatik, Molekularbiologie, Verfahrenstechnik, Analytik und regulatorischer Unterstützung. Ob du als Wissenschaftler*in , Techniker*in, Datenexpert*in oder im operativen Bereich tätig bist – deine Arbeit trägt dazu bei, die Gesundheit von Menschen weltweit zu verbessern. Mit Standorten in Petaluma (USA), Kulmbach und Berlin (Deutschland) und als Teil der LGC Group bieten wir dir ein globales, kooperatives Umfeld als CRO und CDMO. Gestalte bei Axolabs die Zukunft innovativer Wirkstoffe und verantworte als Compliance Manager*in die Einhaltung höchster GMP-Standards in der Oligonukleotid-Produktion. Werde Teil unseres Teams und unsrer Mission: Wissenschaft für eine Sichere Welt . Ihre Aufgaben Sie verantworten die Sicherstellung der GMP-Compliance in der Herstellung von Oligonukleotiden am Standort Berlin. Dabei überwachen und optimieren Sie kontinuierlich unsere Herstellungsprozesse gemäß den geltenden regulatorischen Standards. Sie begleiten Audits, prüfen chargenbezogene Dokumentationen und arbeiten eng mit interdisziplinären Teams aus Produktion und Analytik zusammen. Das bringst Du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium in Chemie, Pharmazie oder vergleichbare naturwissenschaftliche Qualifikation Erfahrung im GMP-regulierten Umfeld Ausgeprägte analytische Stärke, hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und lösungsorientiertes Denken Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, starkes Organisationstalent, eigenständiges Arbeiten und ausgeprägter Teamgeist Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und Qualitätsmanagementsystemen sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Berei

If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Legal Counsel PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk
jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
